items.title: Moldova says seven drones entered its airspace, with five reportedly downed
items.summary: Moldova's Defence Ministry reportedly identified seven drones over the country, with five said to have fallen near settlements and two still unlocated. Airports and all six crossings on the Ukrainian border were reportedly temporarily suspended. The drones' origins and the circumstances of their flights have not been independently confirmed.

items.title: Putin reportedly arrives in Shenzhen for APEC summit and high-level talks
items.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin reportedly arrived in Shenzhen for the APEC summit, with meetings involving Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump on the agenda, including a reported three-way meeting. The content and outcome of any talks concerning Ukraine remain unknown.
